node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one color-degree barrier
node.statement: For a nonconstant degree-d rootwise colored Frobenius interpolant on H reduced roots, the pointwise equations define plane curves of degrees d and d+1 with no common component, so H<=d(d+1). Thus h=7 starts at degree two and h=15 starts at degree four; the h=15 cubic chamber is empty.
node.notes: Exact degree barrier only. Equality or larger degree does not imply existence; h=15 constant and degrees four through thirteen remain open.
